description: The number 153 is the count of fish in the miraculous catch after the resurrection (John 21:11). Mathematically, 153 is the triangular number of 17, that is, the sum of all numbers from 1 to 17. The fact that the net did not tear despite the enormous catch has been interpreted as a symbol of the church's universality and unity – it embraces all nations without falling apart. Thus, the number has come to be understood as a symbol of the complete, universal gathering of believers from every people on earth.

versions.description: The number 153 is the count of fish in the miraculous catch after the resurrection. The number is the triangular number of 17 (the sum of all numbers from 1 to 17). Church Father Jerome believed it represented all known species of fish, and thus all peoples of the world who would be gathered in. Augustine pointed out that it is the sum of the numbers 1 to 17, where 10 (the law) and 7 (grace) are united.
versions.reason: [minor] The description contains interesting facts from Jerome and Augustine that work better as footnotes. This would make the main text more coherent and flowing, while the patristic interpretations get their own footnotes with the correct source category.; [minor] The phrasing 'the miraculous fish catch' has incorrect grammatical gender – it should be 'the miraculous fish catch'.; [minor] The description should mention that the net did not tear (John 21:11), as this is central to the symbolism of the church's unity and universality.

footnotes.text: Church Father Jerome (c. 347–420) claimed that Greek zoologists had cataloged 153 species of fish, and that the number therefore represented all peoples of the world who would be gathered into the church's net.

Augustine (354–430) pointed out that 153 is the sum of the numbers from 1 to 17, and that 17 itself is the sum of 10 (the law, the Ten Commandments) and 7 (grace, the gifts of the Spirit). The catch thus symbolizes the union of law and grace.
153 is also a so-called narcissistic number (or Armstrong number): 1³ + 5³ + 3³ = 1 + 125 + 27 = 153. This mathematical property has fascinated numerologists throughout history.
